facts.fact: The World Bank Group says IFC was anchor investor in a $1.2 billion bond issued by IHS Towers, a Nigerian tower company, mobilising more than $1.1 billion from private investors; the document gives no date for the issue, so as_of is its publication date, 2026-10-11, and the deal's own year is not stated.

systems.country_label: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth (BRIDGE) Project
systems.owner: Government of Nigeria with World Bank

note: BRIDGE ($156m to $1.1bn) and FINCLUDE ($1.89bn) are mobilisation targets, not signed deals; AGROW, Dangote and Indorama are not digital businesses.
